name: Build-An-AI-Virtual-Mouse-With-OpenCV
headline: AI virtual mouse using OpenCV in Python
short_description: In our continuing deep dive into practical real-time computer vision, we’ll show you how to code a hands-free webcam-based controller for your computer mouse using the OpenCV library on Python. author: The-Assembly

sections.overview:
This skill teaches you to create a virtual mouse controller that responds to hand gestures captured by your webcam. It uses OpenCV to process live camera feeds and MediaPipe Hands to detect and estimate 3D hand landmarks in real-time, without requiring special hardware. The detected hand poses are then translated into mouse movements and actions using the AutoPy automation module. This hands-free approach eliminates the need for traditional input devices and works efficiently even on standard hardware. Developers learning computer vision and automation will gain practical experience building gesture-based interfaces.
Hands-free presentation control and navigation
Accessibility tools for users with mobility limitations
Gesture-based game controller development
Touchless computer interaction in medical or clean environments
